gap: LLMs don't know corridor-specific recruitment-fee bans, the employer-pays principle, or which intermediaries are licensed; they give generic answers that miss bilateral-agreement specifics
public_source: ILO General Principles & Operational Guidelines for Fair Recruitment + IRIS Standard + bilateral labor agreements (ILO, reusable)
lift_rationale: low economic_value + thin data + jurisdiction/corridor-specific = deep valley; high human stakes (debt bondage), exact rules verifiable against ILO texts

gap: models can't state which ILO conventions a given country has ratified, when, or with what reservations; they assume universal adoption
lift_rationale: (country x convention) ratification graph the model lacks; exact, verifiable, and ignored by frontier R&D (low economic value)

gap: LLMs invent refugee status determination steps, appeal timelines, and documentary requirements that vary sharply by country of asylum
public_source: UNHCR RSD procedural standards + country operations guidance (UNHCR, reusable)
lift_rationale: procedure-heavy, country-specific, low-resource population; no automated success signal so models lag — classic valley with high humanitarian stakes

gap: models default to US/EU labor norms and miss national wage/hours/termination/severance provisions of countries with little online legal text
public_source: national labor codes + ILO NATLEX legislative database (ILO, public)
lift_rationale: thin training data (under-digitized jurisdictions) + low economic incentive = valley; provisions are exact statutory text

gap: models don't know corridor-specific remittance limits, KYC tiers, mobile-money rules, or hawala treatment that differ per sending/receiving country pair
public_source: FATF guidance + national central-bank remittance rules + World Bank Remittance Prices (public)
lift_rationale: (corridor x rule) graph, under-documented, low-income-population focus = valley; verifiable against regulator texts

gap: LLMs lack country-specific birth-registration, late-registration, and statelessness-determination procedures critical for undocumented populations
public_source: UNHCR statelessness handbook + UNICEF civil-registration guidance + national civil-status codes (public)
lift_rationale: deeply under-resourced domain, no economic signal, high stakes; procedures are exact and citeable

gap: models mistranslate legal/administrative terms in under-resourced languages, producing dangerous errors in rights, eligibility, and procedure
public_source: community-validated bilingual legal glossaries + UNTERM + national legal-aid bodies (reusable w/ attribution)
lift_rationale: low data coverage (under-resourced languages) = valley; exact term mappings verifiable and token-efficient (substitute long phrases)

gap: models give resource-rich-context advice; they miss WHO IMCI/community protocols designed for settings without labs, imaging, or specialists
public_source: WHO IMCI + community health worker guidelines (WHO, reusable)
lift_rationale: protocol-exact, low-resource-setting-specific, low commercial R&D attention = valley; high health stakes

gap: models lack ASM-specific mercury-handling, ventilation, and Minamata-Convention obligations for informal small-scale miners
public_source: Minamata Convention on Mercury + UNEP/ILO ASM guidance (public)
lift_rationale: informal, low-income, under-regulated sector ignored by frontier R&D; safety rules exact and citeable

gap: models give generic agronomy and miss staple-crop spacing/timing/pest thresholds specific to agroclimatic zones and local varieties
public_source: FAO crop guides + CGIAR/national extension materials (FAO/CGIAR, reusable)
lift_rationale: zone- and variety-specific, low-digitization, subsistence-economy focus = valley; agronomic facts verifiable
